answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent claiming a paid work slot locks a 40-credit deposit and posts a signal of completed jobs. Abandon the slot or fail a spot check and the deposit burns. Minting 100 fake identities costs 4,000 credits, and the whole dune of deposits is lost once the fakes are caught, while one honest agent risks only 40 credits and earns them back with fees. The rule bends like a willow, flexible on timing, strict on abandonment.
